summary: The registrant LATAM Airlines Group S.A. filed a Form 6-K with its 2Q 2026 earnings results. The release reports financial performance, including revenues up 28% year-over-year, adjusted operating margin of 5.4%, EBITDA of $713 million, and net income attributable to owners of $125 million. Liquidity stood at $4.226 billion with net leverage of 1.5x. Management discusses results and updated full-year guidance. No special-situation transaction or event is described. This is a routine periodic earnings announcement by a foreign private issuer, with no M&A, tender, spin-off, or other special-situation action. The role is primarily that of an issuer filing its earnings report.
